name: @sos-2/orchestrator
description: SOS 2.0 Spirit Orchestrator (Work Order P6): the governed control loop of the persistent Spirit over the merged P2 live-store records and the P5 Harness Contract / Body Broker / Execution Fabric. MISSION-AWARE DECOMPOSITION: a Mission (consumed from @sos-2/mission) decomposes into a durable task graph — decomposition is a TYPED RECORD (inputs, plan, rationale) routed through the reasoning broker as NON-AUTHORITATIVE input; the task graph itself is authoritative structure built by DETERMINISTIC CODE. Up to THREE concurrent worker lanes with assignment only onto DISJOINT owned-path scopes — a collision is a typed assignment denial, never silent overlap (pinned). Typed assignment + handoff records (task, lane, worker ref, lease ref; the handoff carries authority context + workspace revision); pause/resume/cancel as first-class section 9 operations with durable state transitions. ASK ESCALATION through @sos-2/ask's AskQueue — ASK IS A SUCCESS STATE, never an exception class, never a silent bypass (pinned). WORKER RESULT INGESTION: results arrive as evidence-bound records and route to INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION — a worker reporting completion NEVER certifies mission success (no self-approval); the verification record gates task COMPLETED transitions (pinned). THE ARCHITECT ROLE IS A GOVERNED CONTROL FUNCTION: typed ArchitectGate records for consequential transitions (merge/promote/deploy-class), carrying the authority reference acted under; the architect function is recorded, bounded, and CANNOT MINT AUTHORITY — every bypass attempt is a typed violation naming the field and rule (pinned). Determinism: no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env in this package's src — the clock, stores, broker, fabric and providers are injected.
